notes.title: Tanked Out! Update 1.2!!!
notes.content:
🔫 New Turrets, More Mayhem:
Unleash chaos with a brand-new arsenal of turrets! From a rapid-fire shotgun to strategic mines, these fresh additions will revolutionize your battlefield tactics. Experiment with the new turrets and discover game-changing combinations that will keep your opponents guessing.

🎉 Revamped Menus for a Sleeker Experience:
We've given our menus a stylish makeover for a more streamlined and user-friendly experience. Navigate through Tanked Out! with ease and enjoy a polished interface that enhances your overall tanking journey.

🎮 Fun Game Options for Endless Variety:
Dive into a world of endless possibilities with new game options! Customize your matches like never before with exciting tweaks and modifiers that will keep every round feeling fresh and unpredictable. Whether you're seeking a casual skirmish or an intense try not to die challenge, these options let you tailor the experience to your liking.

🎵 Audio Rework for Immersive Battles:
Immerse yourself in the explosive sounds of tank warfare with our audio rework! Every sound has been carefully tuned and turned into 3D to enhance the intensity and excitement of your battles. Turn up the volume and get ready to be fully immersed in the Tanked Out! experience.

🐞 Bug Fixes for a Smoother Ride:
We've squashed pesky bugs to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Your feedback matters, and we've been hard at work addressing issues to provide you with a polished and bug-free Tanked Out! experience.
